title: CloudTrail logging stopped or trail deleted
description: The event indicates that recording was stopped or the trail was deleted. Review coverage to determine whether an audit gap followed.
falsepositives: Approved retirement or migration of a trail.
recommended_action: Check the change window, delivery status, alternative trails, and the last available event for this trail.
notes: Pattern match requires analyst validation. ATT&CK mapping uses the documented v17 reference snapshot.
